description: This file defines the MemorySessionStorage class which implements the SessionStorageInterface for in-memory session management within the OrangeHRM system. It manages session bags and metadata, providing methods to start, regenerate, clear, and access session data.

classes.name: MemorySessionStorage
classes.description: Implements an in-memory session storage mechanism adhering to the SessionStorageInterface, managing session bags and metadata within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of MemorySessionStorage with a fresh MetadataBag.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Signals the start of the session, always returning true.

methods.name: isStarted
methods.description: Checks if the session has started, always returning true.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the session ID, which in this implementation is an empty string.

methods.name: regenerate
methods.description: Regenerates the session, optionally destroying existing data; updates metadata if destroyed.

methods.name: getBag
methods.description: Retrieves a session bag by name, throws exception if not registered.

methods.name: registerBag
methods.description: Registers a session bag with the storage.

methods.name: getMetadataBag
methods.description: Returns the MetadataBag associated with the session storage.
